title: fix(lint)!: os build refuses a flow or hook condition that orders an injected column a stored row can hold null in, as the publish gate does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TDTX7iNkw3ugZTbLqZFUtx)_

Fixes #33435

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches a condition over an injected column or the null guard on one; `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` and `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` gain the rule in this change.

> **BREAKING** for a stack whose record-triggered flow condition or hook `condition` orders or does arithmetic on an injected system column the object does not declare (`owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`, `organization_id`; `created_at` / `updated_at` at a `beforeInsert` hook) with no `!= null` guard: `os build` now refuses it, as the runtime publish gate already did. ADR-0087: `registered flow-hook-condition-injected-column-null-guard-at-build`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os build` 在 flow 条件和 hook 条件里，对平台注入列（负责人、创建人、修改人、业务单元、队列、组织）做大小比较或算术而没先判空时，现在会报错，和发布时的服务端检查给出同一条结论；`beforeInsert` 钩子里的创建/修改时间也一样。
- 为什么改：实测这些列在系统写入、种子数据、访客写入的行上是空的，条件一碰就出错：flow 跑失败（触发它的写入照样落库），hook 条件直接让写入失败。以前本地构建放行、发布才拒，作者在发布时才第一次看到错误。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧构建期检查，运行时与发布检查不变；四个示例应用和平台对象零命中。回滚即还原 `validate-expressions.ts` 的这次改动。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（`buildInjectedNullableIndex` / `buildPreStampIndex` 和 `checkNullGuards` 的 `nullable` 选项），`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts` 新增的对齐用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`，应见 29 passed，其中 #33435 的用例逐列断言构建与发布检查结论相同。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`: the flow condition sites (start, edge, `decision` branch; `record.` and bare spellings) and the hook condition site now judge the null guard over the declared fields **plus** the injected system columns the object as read does not carry (`buildInjectedNullableIndex`). At `os build` that is every injected column the author did not declare; at a single-item runtime door the objects are served with those columns declared, so the index adds nothing there and its verdicts do not move. Two runtime readers hand the walk authored objects and so narrow with the build, inside the declared narrowing: the MCP `validate_expression` tool at site `flow_condition` (`judgeAuthoredSiteExpression` strips the injected columns and runs the walk as a flow write) now returns the null-guard finding for the six columns, and a `publish-drafts` batch that carries a draft of the flow's or hook's own object (`mergePendingDeclarations` replaces the served object with the draft body, which holds no injected column) now refuses what it published before, as the single-item publish already refused it. A hook whose `events` include `beforeInsert` also judges `created_at` / `updated_at` (`buildPreStampIndex`), the card's S1 case. Validation rules and `requiredWhen` keep the declared-field index: both doors judge those over the authored object (measured below), so they already agree.
- The `PLATFORM_STAMPED_COLUMNS` docblock records the per-column measurement; the orphaned `buildNullableFieldIndex` docblock (it said leaving the injected columns out "costs coverage, never a false error") moves above its function and says what the index is now.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.…` `reason`: a `beforeInsert` hook reads `created_at` / `updated_at` as null only when it runs before the stamp (priority below 10); the rule stays the door's (#33434), a priority-aware rule at both doors is the seat's follow-up.
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (rule 5) and `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx` (the `condition` gate) state that the injected columns need the guard and the two timestamps do not, except at `beforeInsert`.
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `flow-hook-condition-injected-column-null-guard-at-build`; root changeset `33435-injected-column-null-guard-at-build.md` (`@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec` minor).

## Measurement (card step 1)

<details><summary>Per column, per ownership tier, per writer (showcase, real REST door + engine, driver-sqlite-wasm, single posture)</summary>

Throwaway probe (deleted): the showcase stack plus three objects, one per ownership tier (default/user, `business_unit`, `org`), a REST `POST /data/OBJECT` as the platform admin and as a signed-up member, then `ql.insert` under `{ isSystem: true }` with and without `tenantId`, a system update and an admin REST update of each system row; hooks registered at priority 1 recorded what each event saw; three record-after-create flows on the user-tier object.

| column | REST create (admin, member) | system insert | after a user REST update of a system row | seeded `showcase_task` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `organization_id` | set | set (Default Organization) | set | set |
| `owner_id` (user tier) | stamped to the caller | NULL | NULL | claimed by the admin |
| `queue` (user tier) | NULL | NULL | NULL | NULL |
| `owning_business_unit_id` (user, business_unit tiers) | NULL | NULL | NULL | NULL |
| `created_by` | stamped | NULL | NULL | NULL |
| `updated_by` | stamped | NULL (a system update leaves it NULL) | stamped | NULL |
| `created_at`, `updated_at` | set | set | set | set |

- A `beforeInsert` hook at priority 1 saw a payload with no `organization_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by` for every writer (REST and system); `afterInsert` saw them stamped. `organization_id` is filled by the driver after the hook chain.
- Reach: system inserts fire record-triggered flows and every hook. `record.owner_id > 'a'` and `record.created_by > 'a'` start conditions: each system insert's run `failed` with `condition failed to evaluate as CEL: no such overload: dyn<null> > string`; the REST create's run `completed`; the guarded `record.owner_id != null && record.owner_id > 'a'` flow never failed.
- `posture-only` (isolated) boot: a system-context insert with no organization is refused (`SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError`, ADR-0131 D9), so no NULL row there.
- By design, not re-measured: a guest/public-form write leaves `owner_id` unset (ADR-0138 D1 item 5), a queue park or release writes `owner_id: null` (ADR-0142 D3, `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`), and driver-memory never stamps a tenant column (`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-tenancy-guard.ts` header).

Decision (card step 2): no column is stamped for some ownership tiers only, so no STOP. `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue` hold NULL on reachable stored rows ⇒ nullable at both. `organization_id` is set on every stored row on the SQL family but read NULL at `beforeInsert` and never stamped by driver-memory ⇒ not every reachable row, so it stays nullable at the door and is now nullable at the build (the door already judged it so). `created_at` / `updated_at` stay never-null except at a `beforeInsert` hook (S1).

Gate-level reading before/after (lint functions, same object, every tier): base `f81e4b6c` — flow/hook sites door=1 build=0 for each of the six columns, `beforeInsert` hook on `created_at`/`updated_at` door=1 build=0, validation rule door=0 build=0; head — build equals door in every cell.

</details>

## First-party exposure (card step 3)

`objectstack build` at head in `examples/app-todo`, `app-crm`, `app-multi-package`, `app-showcase`: exit 0 each, zero null-guard findings. Positive control: `examples/app-todo`'s `todo_task_completion` start condition with `&& record.created_by > "a"` appended (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty) ⇒ exit 1 with `applies \`>\` to \`record.created_by\``. Platform packages: `git grep` finds no flow or hook condition ordering an injected column (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/predicate-matrix.action.ts` uses `owner_id ==` in an action `visible`, not a judged site). No hit to guard.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`: the #33246 describe is renamed to cover both cards and gains seven cases: os build refuses each of the six columns at every flow slot and at a hook with the door's exact finding; a flow's bare spelling (judged as a declared nullable field's, the door judges no bare name of either kind); per ownership tier the build judges exactly the columns the tier carries; the S1 `beforeInsert` case and its afterInsert/flow controls; the guarded spelling; an author-declared `owner_id` keeps its own verdict; a validation rule keeps its verdict at both.
- `packages/lint/src/authored-site-expression.test.ts`: the MCP `flow_condition` entry over a served object returns the gate's null-guard finding for `record.owner_id > 'a'`, and nothing for the guarded spelling.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.injected-column-null-guard.test.ts` (new): `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` with the object's draft in `pending.objects` refuses a flow over `owner_id` and a `beforeInsert` hook over `created_at` exactly as the single-item publish does; the guarded spelling publishes. Ablation: with base `validate-expressions.ts` (lint rebuilt) both batch cases and the MCP case fail; restored, they pass.
- Forced test edit: `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts` — the #5017 declared-keys meta-test's `PLUMBING` table gains the five new non-metadata receivers (`flowHookNullableIndex`, `preStampIndex`, `carriedFieldNames`, `joinedNullable`, `joinedFields`).

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, named for the seat: a hop leaf through an injected lookup (`record.owner_id.nmae != null`) is judged at neither the build nor the door.
- Residual build/door difference left on purpose (the order scoped `created_at` / `updated_at` to the S1 case): the door also refuses, and the build accepts, arithmetic on `record.created_at` in a flow, a `previous.created_at` read, a read-event hook (`beforeFind` / `afterFind`) on the two timestamps, and every timestamp read on an `external` object.
- Validation rules and `requiredWhen` over an injected column are judged at neither door (the object door judges the authored object); a stored row with NULL there faults the rule. Same class, not this card's sites.
- The null-guard message names the object as declaring the column nullable ("'todo_task' declares as nullable (no `required: true`, no `defaultValue`)") for an injected column the author never declared; it is the door's existing wording, kept identical for parity.

## Verification

All readings at head `f1e07bac` (the final commit), worktree on `origin/main` `f81e4b6c`.

<details><summary>Tests, consumers, dogfood, gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 212 passed (212), Tests 9033 passed (9033); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Consumers of the build verdict (the contract face is `os build` / `os validate`; the single-item door's verdicts do not move; the MCP `flow_condition` entry and `publish-drafts` batches move as "What changes" says): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit` 423/423 files, 6010/6010 tests; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 342 passed, 9 skipped files, 22926 passed, 45 skipped tests; `@objectstack/mcp` 65/65 files, 1185/1185; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 122/122 files, 2007/2007. All exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (`(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 467 passed, 3 skipped (470), Tests 3962 passed, 42 skipped (4004).
- `objectstack build` in the four examples: exit 0 each; positive control exit 1 (see First-party exposure).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 109 commands, each run with stdin closed and the exit captured before any pipe; `--ran`: 109 derived, 108 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (not every package has a `dist/`), CI runs it. Three first-pass exit 3 refusals re-run green after their prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone; `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876`, 48 cases), `check:skill-examples` (built `@objectstack/client-react...`; 346 prose examples), `check:type-check-debt` (lock wait behind the dogfood run; re-run with a slot, OK).

</details>
